In an anion exchange chromatography, the matrix is

answers.a: The hydrophobic groups present on matrix interact with charged groups on the target proteins.
answers.b: The hydrophobic patches on the analyte interact with hydrophobic groups on the matrix.
answers.c: Specific interaction between substrate and enzyme occurs.

questions.question: The interaction of proteins with HIC column involves:
The use of high salt concentration for binding of proteins into an HIC column is based on the principle that:

answers.a: High salt concentration precipitates the proteins which stick into the column matrix
answers.b: High salt concentration removes hydration layer of the proteins and exposes their hydrophobic residues
answers.c: High salt concentration removes small molecular weight proteins that interfere with binding
answers.d: High salt concentration helps protein in forming hydrogen bonding with the column matrix
